title: Final Intensity Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct intensity distribution equation I = I_0 (sin(β)/β)^2 cos^2(γ).

title: Definitions of β and γ
description: Important Criteria: The student should define β and γ correctly in terms of the slit width a, slit separation d, wavelength λ, and angle θ.

title: Missing Orders Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain why certain orders of interference are missing due to the ratio d/a = 5.

title: Sketch of Pattern
description: Optional Criteria: A clear sketch of the interference pattern on the screen should be included to illustrate the concept.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all variables are expressed in consistent units, avoiding any unit mistakes.
